**Windows:** download the zip, extract the whole folder and run `TraductorRenPy.exe`. Read `READ_ME_FIRST.txt` inside.
**Windows:** descarga el zip, extrae toda la carpeta y ejecuta `TraductorRenPy.exe`. Lee `LEEME.txt` dentro.

**"Windows protected your PC" / "Windows protegió su PC"**: expected, the file is not code-signed (a paid certificate).
Click **More info → Run anyway** / **Más información → Ejecutar de todas formas**. The full source code is in this repository.

You also need the free [Ren'Py SDK](https://www.renpy.org/latest.html) and an API key (Gemini has a free tier).
Necesitas además el [Ren'Py SDK](https://www.renpy.org/latest.html) (gratis) y una clave de API (Gemini tiene nivel gratuito).

See [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/TraductorRenPy/TraductorRenPy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed. Questions and feedback: [Discussions](https://github.com/TraductorRenPy/TraductorRenPy/discussions).
